method.method_draft: First describe the image as a table of initial concentrations and initial formation rates. Let Rate=k[A]^m[B]^n. Divide the rate expression for experiment 2 by experiment 1: (6×10^-2)/(3×10^-2)=([0.20]/[0.20])^m([0.20]/[0.10])^n, so 2=2^n and n=1. Then divide experiment 3 by experiment 2: (6×10^-2)/(6×10^-2)=([0.40]/[0.20])^m([0.20]/[0.20])^n, so 1=2^m and m=0. Substitute m=0 and n=1 to get Rate=k[A]^0[B]=k[B].
